description: Source code for a meta-cognitive, self-reasoning multi-agent system implementing a 12-phase pipeline for document question answering, including chunking, query analysis, retrieval, answer synthesis, drift detection, and confidence calibration.

classes.name: Agent
classes.description: Main agent class managing the reasoning pipeline and memory interactions.

classes.name: AIConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for AI model parameters.

classes.name: Chunk
classes.description: Represents a document chunk with id, text, and metadata.

classes.name: ChunkList
classes.description: Container for a list of Chunk objects and total count.

classes.name: SubQuestion
classes.description: Represents an atomic sub-question for decomposition.

classes.name: SubQuestions
classes.description: Container for multiple SubQuestion objects.

classes.name: QuerySemantics
classes.description: Schema capturing the semantic analysis of a query.

classes.name: PrecisionRequirements
classes.description: Schema defining the required precision level for retrieval.

classes.name: RetrievalPlan
classes.description: Schema describing the designed retrieval strategy.

classes.name: RankedChunk
classes.description: Chunk with an associated relevance score for ranking.

classes.name: DraftAnswer
classes.description: Schema for a draft answer with confidence and gaps.

classes.name: MatchQuality
classes.description: Schema for evaluating the relevance and quality of a chunk match.

classes.name: DraftAnswerWithEntities
classes.description: Answer with extracted entities and confidence.

classes.name: DriftAnalysis
classes.description: Schema for analyzing semantic drift and entity substitution.

classes.name: AlignmentVerdict
classes.description: Final verdict on whether answer aligns with the question.

classes.name: FinalConfidence
classes.description: Calibrated confidence score with reasoning.

classes.name: Claim
classes.description: Atomic verifiable claim extracted from text.

classes.name: ClaimList
classes.description: Collection of Claim objects.

classes.name: VerificationResult
classes.description: Result of claim verification against source chunks.

classes.name: Citation
classes.description: Citation info linking answer to source chunks.

classes.name: VerifiedAnswer
classes.description: Final answer with citations, confidence, and verification summary.

classes.name: Gaps
classes.description: List of identified information gaps in answer synthesis.
